title: Kaya Session Volume Gym Area Leaderboard
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kaya:session
| stats avg(problems_completed) as avg_value max(problems_completed) as peak_value count as sessions by gym_area
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks gym area values by average and peak problems completed, helping you see where kaya session volume performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which gym area contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `gym_area` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of gym area, average problems completed, and peak problems completed.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which gym area areas give you the strongest kaya session volume results.
